title: Snowball
rule: Caption n has exactly n words, one to eight.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p35_snowball.py (screen and puppet tools: build/p05_noir.py; figures and set pieces: build/b1m2.py)
made: HANDMADE black cut-paper silhouette puppets of the b1m2 model (agent in profile with cut spectacles, waistcoat buttons, pencil, pinned joints; the stranger as a soft grey bust held back beyond the glass) and cut set pieces (desk and lamp, ticket window with TICKET OFFICE cut through its header, wall clock at 4:09 and 4:10, cupboard with its leaf on the left jamb, SERVICE door)
page 05's lamp-lit paper screen (LoC 1934 sheet fibre), even lamp, no blind slats
the ANRC 1922 key cutout as the one brass gel on its hook with a SERVICE tag (close-up in shot 7)
eight shots that grow as the captions grow: four rows 520/600/680/760 px tall, the right shot of each row wider (ratio n+4 : n+5)
eight pasted caption slips in the shared pen hand, of 1, 2, 3 ... 8 words; the four canon lines in cut-paper balloons (not captions, not counted)
captions: He opens the cupboard door wide.
There hangs the brass key, tagged SERVICE.
He has quite forgotten what he came for.

events.E0: shots 1-2 (desk and memo slip '4:15 - open SERVICE door. Key in cupboard.'; risen, walking to the cupboard)
events.E3: shot 5 thanks; she turns from the glass
events.E4: shots 6-7 the cupboard opened, the key on its hook tagged SERVICE
events.E5: shot 8 pencil at his chin, the forgetting line; key on its hook; SERVICE door shut

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: the snowball rolls: one shot per frame, each larger than the last, its caption one word longer

self_check.check: A reader counts 1, 2, 3 ... 8 words in the captions (measured: word counts asserted at build time; hyphen-free, 'SERVICE' counted as one word; perceptually judged at full size: each caption on its own slip top left)
self_check.evidence: measured (word counts, size, bytes) and perceptually judged (full-size page) by the maker

weaknesses: the medium and set pieces repeat pages 05/30 closely; only the growing shots set it apart
the shot growth is gentle (520 to 760 px tall) and may not be noticed as part of the rule
caption 7 wraps to two lines, which can make a reader recount
the stranger is a grey shadow beyond the glass, as on pages 05 and 30
